title: Missing zero-address validation in constructors (NFTMigrator, BurnerV2, GatherV2)
description: Constructors in NFTMigrator, BurnerV2, and GatherV2 accept critical addresses without zero-address checks; a zero address bricks the flow at use time (downstream calls revert).
attackPath: Constructors accept critical addresses without zero-address checks; a zero address bricks the flow at use time.
recommendation: Add require(addr != address(0)) validation for each critical constructor argument in NFTMigrator, BurnerV2, and GatherV2.
justification: Code-hardening recommendation, no attack path -> QA bundle.
